blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate segmentation of the mitral valve from three-dimensional transesophageal echocardiography (3D TEE) is severely restricted by the scarcity of publicly available expert- annotated volumetric datasets. To address this critical limitation, we investigated Fourier Domain Adaptation (FDA), utilizing general-purpose generative-AI images (from platforms like Chat- GPT, Google Gemini, and Microsoft MAI) as annotation-free style donors for 3D mitral valve segmentation. We employed a DeepMitral residual U-Net model on the public MVSeg2023 dataset, comparing six conditions over three runs: real-only training, traditional augmentation, FDA with each generative source, and a non-AI FDA control using real-image style donors, plus an optimization-matched real-only control and a \b{eta} sensitivity analysis. Case-level paired testing showed that FDA with these generative sources led to significant reductions in boundary- and surface-related errors across all three donor conditions relative to the primary real-only baseline. However, the impact on the core segmentation metric, Generalized Dice Score (GDS), proved generator-dependent. ChatGPT-FDA showed a significant GDS advantage over the optimization-matched control but not over the primary baseline, and Gemini-FDA showed no significant GDS difference. Notably, only MAI-FDA provided a statistically robust and significant increase in GDS compared to the primary baseline. The \b{eta} sensitivity was not robust across training runs. These findings confirm that FDA remains an important augmentation mechanism. While generative-AI images offer a practical means of acquiring style diversity without new annotations, the non-AI control performed comparably to ChatGPT-FDA, so we do not conclude that this approach is superior to training with real-image donors.
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏公开提供的专家注释卷片数据集,从三维横断面式回声心电图(3D TEE)中精确分解的线粒体阀受到严格限制. 为了解决这一关键限制,我们调查了Fourier Domain Reformation(FDA),利用通用基因-AI图像(来自Chat-GPT,Google双子座和Microsoft MAI等平台)作为3D线粒体阀门分割的无注释风格捐赠者. 我们在公共MVSeg2023数据集上采用了DeepMitral残余U-Net模型,将六个条件比作三个运行条件:真实的训练、传统的增强、FDA和每个基因源,以及非AI的FDA控制,使用真实图像风格的捐赠者,加上优化匹配的真实的控制和\b{eta}敏感性分析。 个案一级的对等测试显示,林业发展局与这些基因来源相比,所有三个捐助方条件的边界和地表误差都比主要实际基线大为减少。 然而,对核心分化度量度(通用二分分数)的影响证明取决于发电机。 ChatGPT-FDA显示GDS相对于优化匹配的控制具有显著的优势,但相对于主基线则没有,双子座-FDA显示没有显著的GDS差异. 值得注意的是,只有MAI-FDA提供了与主要基线相比,GDS在统计上强劲和显著的增长。 整个训练环节的敏感性并不强。 这些调查结果证实,林业发展局仍然是一个重要的增强机制。 虽然Generative-AI图像提供了在没有新说明的情况下获得风格多样性的实用手段,但非AI控制比照ChatGPT-FDA进行,因此我们不认为这种方法优于对真实图像捐赠者的培训.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Mitral valve disease, including degenerative mitral regurgitation, functional regurgitation, and rheumatic stenosis, is among the most common structural cardiac conditions requiring surgical or transcatheter intervention [ 1 , 2 ] . Three-dimensional transesophageal echocardiography (3D TEE) is the clinical reference modality for assessing mitral valve morphology because it captures the dynamic, saddle-shaped leaflet geometry that two-dimensional imaging cannot fully resolve [ 3 ] . Extracting a case-specific mitral valve surface model from a 3D TEE volume is essential for pre-operative planning, in-silico repair simulation, and quantitative assessment of leaflet coaptation, but manual segmentation of a single 3D TEE volume can take a trained operator upwards of two hours [ 4 ] , making it impractical for routine clinical workflows.
blocks.zh: 肌瓣病,包括脱发性肌动脉再生,功能再生,和风湿性激素化,是最常见的需要外科手术或转动器干预的结构心脏病[1,2]. 三维截面回声心电图(3D TEE)是评估双子阀形态学的临床参考模式,因为它能捕捉到二维成像不能完全解决的活性,鞍形活页几何. [3]. 从3D TEE体积中提取出一个案例特异性的线粒体阀表面模型,对于操作前的规划,硅胶修复模拟,以及传单拼接量的定量评估都是必不可少的,但是手动分解单个3D TEE体积可以让训练有素的操作员上行2小时[4],因此对于常规的临床工作流程来说是不切实际的.

blocks.en: Deep learning has substantially reduced this burden. Carnahan et al. introduced DeepMitral, a fully automatic 3D residual U-Net that segments the mitral leaflets directly from raw TEE volumes in seconds rather than hours [ 4 ] , and the same group subsequently released the associated data through the MVSeg2023 public challenge [ 5 ] . Despite this progress, the fundamental data bottleneck of medical image segmentation persists: MVSeg2023 provides only 105 annotated training volumes, an order of magnitude smaller than the datasets that power state-of-the-art segmentation frameworks such as nnU-Net in other anatomical domains [ 6 ] . Because 3D TEE annotation requires simultaneous expertise in cardiac anatomy and ultrasound interpretation, this scarcity is unlikely to be resolved through additional manual labelling alone.

blocks.en: A parallel line of work has explored synthetic data generation as a remedy for small medical imaging datasets. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have been used to augment liver lesion classification [ 7 ] , and surveys of GAN-based medical image synthesis document dozens of similar applications across radiology and pathology [ 8 , 9 ] . More recently, large-scale vision-language foundation models have been shown capable of synthesizing clinically coherent chest X-rays conditioned on radiology reports [ 10 ] , and a concurrent study demonstrated that a general-purpose commercial image generator (Nano Banana, the image-generation component of Google Gemini) can produce synthetic chest radiographs realistic enough to train a pneumonia classifier that generalizes to real-world X-ray datasets with an AUROC of up to 0.923 0.923 [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 并行的工作路线探索了合成数据的生成,作为小型医疗成像数据集的补救办法. 基因异常网络(GANs)被用于增强肝脏损伤分类[7],对基于GAN的医学影像合成调查记录了数十种在放射学和病理学上的类似应用[8,9]. 最近,大规模视觉语言基础模型被证明能够合成临床上一致的胸X射线,以放射学报告为条件[10],同时进行的一项研究表明,一个通用商业图像生成器(Google双子座图像生成组件Nano Banana)能够生产出足够现实的合成胸X射线图来训练一种肺炎分类器,将一般化为现实世界X射线数据集,AUROC可达0.923 0.923 [11].

blocks.en: This study follows Peng et al. [ 11 ] , who showed that off-the-shelf, non-medical generative AI tools (requiring no fine-tuning or specialized medical training data) can produce synthetic images with measurable downstream classification utility. We ask whether this paradigm extends from 2D image classification to 3D TEE segmentation , a substantially harder problem for two reasons. First, segmentation requires a dense, voxel-accurate label for every training example, whereas classification requires a single scalar label, and general-purpose text-to-image generators such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and MAI-Image-2.6 cannot produce such masks. Second, 3D TEE is volumetric while consumer generative models output only 2D raster images, a dimensional mismatch that naïve augmentation cannot resolve.
blocks.zh: 这项研究随后进行 彭等 [11],他显示现成的非医学基因AI工具(不需要微调或专业医学培训数据)可以生成可测量下游分类效用的合成图像. 我们问这个范式是否从2D图像分类扩展至3D TEE分解, 第一,分化需要每个训练实例都有一个密集的,活性准确的标签,而分类则需要一个单一的分解标签,而ChatGPT,双子座和MAI-Image-2.6等通用的文本到图像生成器不能产生这样的口罩. 第二,3D TEE是量子的,而消费者基因模型只输出2D光栅图像,这种维不匹配是天真的增强无法解决的.

blocks.en: We address both obstacles with a single procedure. Rather than treating synthetic images as independent training examples requiring annotation, we use each 2D image purely as a style reference and apply Fourier Domain Adaptation (FDA) [ 12 ] to transfer selected low-frequency amplitude components onto a real, already-annotated 3D TEE volume. Because FDA retains the real-image phase, the volume’s spatial organization is expected to remain largely unchanged, so we reuse the original expert mask rather than claiming that every anatomical feature is exactly preserved. This turns the 2D-image-to-3D-mask annotation problem into a label-preserving appearance-transfer problem, yielding additional labelled 3D training volumes without new manual segmentation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过单一程序处理这两个障碍。 我们不把合成图像作为需要注释的独立训练实例,而是将每个2D图像纯粹用作样式参考,并应用Fourier Domain Refect(FDA)[12]将选定的低频振幅组件传输到一个真实的,已经附加说明的3D TEE卷. 因为FDA保留了真实的图像相相,所以预计量的空间组织将基本保持不变,因此我们重新使用原来的专家口罩,而不是声称每个解剖特征都得到了完全保存. 这使得2D-image-to-3D-mask的注解问题变成了一个保留标签的外观-转移问题,产生额外的标注为3D的训练卷而无需新的手动分解.

blocks.en: We construct three generator-guided FDA training sets, derived from ChatGPT (GPT-Image), Google Gemini (Nano Banana), and Microsoft MAI-Image-2.6, and compare them with a non-AI FDA control, a real-only baseline, and traditional augmentation, giving six experimental conditions. Our contributions are:

We use slice-wise 2D FDA to bridge the dimensional mismatch between 2D generated images and 3D segmentation training: the synthetic image contributes low-frequency appearance, while the real-image phase and original expert mask are retained, avoiding voxel-level label generation. 3. blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Mitral Valve and Cardiac Structure Segmentation: Automated mitral valve segmentation from 3D TEE has progressed from atlas-based and active-contour methods to deep learning. Andreassen et al. used a deep convolutional network for mitral annulus segmentation in 3D TEE [ 13 ] . Carnahan et al.’s DeepMitral applied a 3D residual U-Net trained with the MONAI framework to segment the full leaflet apparatus directly from raw TEE volumes, achieving strong agreement with manual expert segmentations while reducing processing time from hours to seconds [ 4 ] . Subsequent work has introduced anatomical constraints into mitral annulus segmentation [ 14 ] and explored graph-neural-network representations of continuous leaflet motion across the cardiac cycle [ 15 ] . Chen et al. proposed an automatic 3D mitral valve leaflet segmentation pipeline validated against quantitative clinical measurements [ 16 ] . Across this literature, dataset size remains a recurring limitation, with reported training sets ranging from 44 to about 100 annotated volumes [ 4 , 17 ] —a scale far below that available for more common segmentation targets such as abdominal organs or brain tumors.
blocks.zh: Mitral 阀门和心肌结构分解: 由3D TEE自动的线粒体阀分解从以地图集为基础的活性相接法发展到深入学习。 安德烈亚斯森等. 在3D TEE [13] 中使用了深演化网络来进行平分化。 Carnahan等人的DeepMitral应用了经MONAI框架培训的3D剩余U-Net,直接从原始的TEE卷中分离出完整的传单设备,与人工专家分解取得强烈一致,同时将处理时间从小时减少到秒 [4]。 随后的工作将解剖学限制引入了双子废除分化[14],并探索了整个心脏周期连续活页运动的图-神经-网络表现[15]. 陈等. 提议建立一个自动的3D平面阀单片分解管道,根据定量临床测量加以验证[16]。 在整个文献中,数据集的大小仍是一个经常性的局限性,所报告的培训集从44到约100个注解卷[4,17]——远远低于腹部器官或脑瘤等更常见的分化目标。

blocks.en: Synthetic Medical Image Generation and GAN-Based Augmentation: Frid-Adar et al. utilized GAN-generated synthetic CT liver lesions to improve CNN classification performance on a real dataset [ 7 ] . Kazeminia et al. and Yi et al. subsequently surveyed the rapid expansion of GAN applications across medical image synthesis, segmentation, and cross-modality translation [ 8 , 9 ] . More recently, Bluethgen et al. demonstrated that a vision-language foundation model conditioned on radiology reports could synthesize chest radiographs with clinically coherent pathology [ 10 ] , illustrating the shift from adversarial architectures toward large pretrained generative foundation models for medical image synthesis.
blocks.zh: 合成医学影像生成和以GAN为基础的增强:Frid-Adar等利用由GAN生成的合成CT肝损伤来提高CNN在真数据集上的分类性能[7]. Kazeminia等人和Yi等人著。 随后调查了GAN应用在医学影像合成,分化,和跨模式翻译方面的快速扩展[8,9]. 近来, Bluethgen等人证明,以放射学报告为条件的视觉语言基础模型可以结合临床上一致的病理来合成胸腔放射图[10],说明从对抗式建筑转向医学影像合成的大型先入为主的基因基础模型.

blocks.en: General-purpose Generative AI for Medical Data Augmentation: Very recently, Peng et al. used Nano Banana (Google’s general-purpose, non-medical-specialized image generation model) to synthesize 300 chest radiographs and fine-tuned a ResNet-50 classifier exclusively on this synthetic data, achieving an AUROC of 0.923 0.923 on the real-world RSNA Pneumonia Detection dataset and 0.824 0.824 on an independent Chest X-Ray dataset [ 11 ] . That study also compared against RoentGen-v2, a domain-specialized diffusion model for CXR generation [ 19 ] , finding that the general-purpose Nano Banana model outperformed the CXR-specialized generator once post-processing (watermark and field-of-view cropping) was applied.

blocks.en: III Dataset and Baseline Model
blocks.zh: 三. 数据集和基线模型

blocks.en: MVSeg2023 Dataset: We use the publicly released MVSeg2023 dataset [ 5 ] , comprising 3D TEE volumes with voxel-level mitral valve leaflet annotations, partitioned into 105 training, 30 validation, and 40 test volumes. The dataset was originally released with separate anterior- and posterior-leaflet label classes. Following the pretrained DeepMitral model’s convention, we merge these into a single binary leaflet class (background vs. leaflet) for all experiments, so that results are directly comparable to the publicly released pretrained checkpoint. Voxel spacing varies by volume (approximately 0.2 0.2 – 0.7 0.7 mm per axis), reflecting the heterogeneous acquisition protocols typical of clinical 3D TEE. The 40 held-out test volumes were used exclusively for evaluation and were not used to construct any FDA-adapted training volumes.
blocks.zh: MVSeg2023 (英语). 数据集 : 我们使用公开发布的MVSeg2023数据集[5],包括3D TEE卷,并配有活塞级平面阀门传单说明,分为105个训练,30个验证,40个测试卷. 该数据集最初发布时有单独的前叶和后叶标签类. 根据预先训练的DeepMitral模型的常规,我们把这些合并成一个单一的二进制传单类(背景与传单),供所有实验使用,这样的结果就可以直接与公开释放的预先训练的检查站相比. Voxel相距因体积而异(约0.2 0.2–每轴0.7毫米),反映了临床3D TEE所典型的不同获取协议. 40个搁置的试验卷专门用于评价,没有用来建造林业发展局调整后的培训卷。

blocks.en:
DeepMitral Model: We use the official DeepMitral implementation [ 4 ] , a 3D residual U-Net built on MONAI [ 18 ] with five resolution levels (channel widths 16–32–64–128–256), stride-2 downsampling at each level, two residual units per level, batch normalization, and no dropout.
Training uses random patch-based cropping (with a patch size of 96 3 96^{3} voxels, with foreground-biased sampling).
blocks.zh:
深密模型 : 我们使用DeepMitral的正式执行[4],一个基于MONAI[18]的3D剩余U-Net,有五个分辨率级(通道宽度为16–32–64–128–256),每个级别下标,每级下标2个剩余单元,分批正常化,不辍学.
训练使用随机的以补丁为主的收割(补丁大小为96 3 96^{3}voxels,并带有前缘有偏见的采样).

blocks.en: IV Methodology
blocks.zh: 四 方法

blocks.en: IV-A Overview
blocks.zh: 四. A 概览

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the pipeline. For each of the three generative-AI tools, we (i) generate 40 synthetic 2D TEE images with structured prompts; (ii) apply slice-wise Fourier Domain Adaptation to transfer low-frequency appearance from each 2D donor onto a selected real training volume, retaining the real-image phase and reusing the original expert mask unchanged; (iii) combine the 40 adapted volumes with the 105 real training volumes to form a 145-volume training set; and (iv) train DeepMitral with an identical architecture and optimization protocol. The validation and test splits consist exclusively of real, expert-annotated volumes.
blocks.zh: 图1汇总了管道。 对于3个基因-AI工具,我们(一) 生成40个合成2D TEE图像,并带有结构化的提示符;(二) 采用切片法Fourier域改造,将每个2D捐赠者的低频外观转移到一个选定的真正的培训量上,保留真实的图像相并使用原有的专家口罩不变;(三) 将40个改编的卷与105个真正的培训量合并,形成145个卷的培训量组;以及(四) 培训DeepMitral,其结构和优化协议完全相同。 鉴定和测试分拆完全包括真实的,专家注解的卷.

blocks.en: Six conditions are compared: a real-only baseline, traditional augmentation, and four FDA conditions (ChatGPT-, Gemini-, MAI-, and non-AI FDA). Because the FDA sets contain more volumes than the baseline and therefore receive more optimization updates, we additionally trained a 540-update real-only control matching their budget. A β \beta -sensitivity analysis is also performed.
blocks.zh: 比较了6个条件:一个真正唯一的基线、传统的增强和四个FDA条件(ChatGPT-、双子座、MAI-和非AI FDA)。 由于FDA套装的量比基线多,因此得到更多的优化更新,因此我们额外训练了540个更新的仅能匹配其预算的控制. 还进行了β\β-敏感性分析。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the generator-guided slice-wise 2D Fourier Domain Adaptation pipeline. For each generator, 40 synthetic 2D TEE images serve as appearance-style donors for 40 selected MVSeg2023 training volumes. FDA modifies selected low-frequency amplitude components while retaining the source-image phase. The original expert segmentation mask is reused unchanged. The 40 FDA-adapted volumes are combined with the 105 original real training volumes to form a 145-volume training set for DeepMitral.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:2D Fourier域改造管线的发电机导片概述. 每台发电机,40个合成2D TEE图像作为40个入选的MVSeg2023培训卷的外观式捐赠者. FDA修改了选定的低频振幅组件,同时保留了源图像相. 原专家分解口罩的再利用情况不变. 林业发展局改编的40卷同105卷原始实际训练卷合并,为DeepMiral组成了145卷的训练集.

blocks.en: IV-B Synthetic Image Generation
blocks.zh: IV-B 合成图像生成

blocks.en: For each of three generators, ChatGPT (GPT-Image), Google Gemini (Nano Banana), and Microsoft MAI-Image-2.6, we generated 40 synthetic 2D images of the mid-esophageal TEE mitral valve view. Following the structured-prompt approach of Peng et al. [ 11 ] , an initial prompt requested a plain grayscale ultrasound sector image without on-image text, ECG traces, or angle indicators (which early generations contained), followed by class-specific prompts for normal morphology and for variants consistent with mitral regurgitation, stenosis, and prolapse, to promote structural diversity. All outputs were manually inspected, and images with encoding artifacts were discarded before augmentation.
blocks.zh: 对于ChatGPT(GPT-Image),Google双子座(Nano Banana),和Microsoft MAI-Image-2.6等三台发电机,我们生成了40个合成2D相片的中外相TEE相模阀取景. 遵循彭等的有条理的即时方针. [11],一个初始的即时请求一个平地灰度的超声扇图像,没有上映文字,ECG痕迹,或角度指标(早期后人所包含),然后是正常形态和与相模重振相符合的变体的分类特有提示,以促进结构多样性. 所有产出都经过人工检查,加固前已丢弃有编码文物的图像。

blocks.en: IV-C Slice-wise 2D Fourier Domain Adaptation
blocks.zh: 二维Fourier域适应

blocks.en: Given a real 3D TEE volume I r I_{r} with expert leaflet mask M r M_{r} and a synthetic 2D image I s I_{s} , we applied conventional 2D FDA [ 12 ] independently to each slice of I r I_{r} (i.e., FDA was not implemented as a 3D Fourier transform). Each donor was paired with one real training volume and used for all of its slices. For each slice, the donor was resized to the slice dimensions, both images were normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and a 2D FFT was computed. The central low-frequency region of the slice’s amplitude spectrum was replaced with the donor’s corresponding components using β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 , while the slice’s phase spectrum was retained. An inverse FFT reconstructed each adapted slice, and the slices were restacked in their original order to form the adapted volume I r ′ I_{r}^{\prime} . Because the real phase is retained, spatial organization is expected to remain largely intact, so M r M_{r} was reused unchanged: the donor contributes low-frequency appearance variation while supervision is inherited from the real volume. This lets generated 2D images add appearance diversity to 3D training without synthetic 3D masks or additional annotation.
blocks.zh: 由于一个真正的3D TEE卷Ir I_{r} 加上专家的传单口罩M r M_{r} 和一个合成的2D图像 I s I_{s} 我们独立地将常规的2D FDA [12] 应用到 I r I_{r}的每个片段(即FDA不是作为3D Fourier变换而实施的). 每个捐献者都配有一册真正的培训卷,并用于其所有部分。 对于每个切片,捐赠者被调整到切片尺寸,两个图像都正常化为 [0, 1] [0,1],并计算出一个2D FFT. 切片振幅频谱的中低频区域被取而代之的是使用β=0.01\β=0.01的捐赠者对应组件,而切片相相频被保留. 反向FFT重建了每个被改造的切片,切片按照原来的顺序被重新整理,以形成被改造的第一卷r'I'r}^{\r}^{\prime}. 由于真实相被保留,空间组织预计基本保持完好,所以Mr M_{r}没有被再利用:捐赠者贡献出低频外观变异而监督从真实相中继承. 这样可以生成2D图像,将外观多样性添加到3D训练中而无需合成3D口罩或附加注释.

blocks.en: For each generator, the 40 donors were paired with 40 distinct real training volumes, selected from the 105 with a fixed random seed of 42, which is independent of the training seeds (1, 2, and 3). The same selection and β = 0.01 \beta=0.01 were used for all generators (i.e., β \beta was not tuned per generator).
blocks.zh: 每台发电机的40个捐赠方配对了40个不同的实际培训卷,从105个固定随机种子42个选取,该种子独立于培训种子(1、2、3个)。 同样的选择和β = 0.01\β = 0.01 用于所有发电机(即β\β不调用每个发电机).

blocks.en: IV-D Training Configuration
blocks.zh: 四-D 培训配置

blocks.en:
In order to realize a standardized, rigorously validated protocol, we held the network architecture, optimizer, patch size, and epoch-based training schedule fixed across all six experimental conditions, so that performance differences reflect the training data rather than the protocol.
All experiments used the DeepMitral 3D residual U-Net with 96 3 96^{3} -voxel patches, batch size 4, drop_last=True , NovoGrad with learning rate 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , the same Dice–cross-entropy loss, and a 15-epoch schedule, with three independent training runs per condition.
The primary real-only baseline (105 volumes) yields 26 mini-batches per epoch, i.e., 390 updates; each FDA condition (145 volumes) yields 36 mini-batches per epoch, i.e., 540 updates. The primary baseline used the 105 real training volumes without FDA or other synthetic augmentation, and its three runs were taken from archived original runs. The 540-update real-only control used the same 105 volumes, network, loss, optimizer, batch size, and three-run protocol. The validation and test volumes were never added to the training set.

主要真实基准量(105卷)每纪年可出26个小巴,即390个更新;FDA条件(145卷)每纪年可出36个小巴,即540个更新. 主要基线使用了105个没有FDA或其他合成增强功能的实际训练卷,其3个跑道取自存档的原始跑道。 540-update real-Only Control使用相同的105卷,网络,丢失,优化,批量大小,以及由3个运行的协议. 鉴定和测试卷从未被添加到训练集中.

blocks.en: IV-E Standardized Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 四-E 标准化评价计量

blocks.en: Segmentation quality is assessed with the Generalized Dice Score (GDS) for overlap, the 95th-percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95) for boundary discrepancy, and Surface Distance for mean surface error. Since the anterior and posterior leaflets are merged into one foreground class, GDS reduces to the standard Dice coefficient; we retain the term GDS to reflect the MONAI metric used. All test metrics were computed with an identical protocol: predictions were defined on the DeepMitral 0.3-mm isotropic evaluation grid, the ground truth was resampled to the prediction shape and affine with nearest-neighbor interpolation, and all three metrics were computed on the binary foreground with background excluded. Distances were converted from voxels to mm using the isotropic spacing.
blocks.zh: 分块质量与通用地ice分数(GDS)进行重叠评估,第95-百分位豪斯多夫距离(HD95)进行边界相差评估,表面距离进行平均地表误差评估。 由于前作和后作的传单被合并为一个前作类,因此GDS降低到标准的Dice系数;我们保留了GDS一词,以反映所使用的MONAI度量. 所有测试度量衡都是用一个相同的协议计算出来的:在DeepMitral 0.3-mm等分线评价网格上确定了预测值,地面真实度被重印到预测外形和近邻插值的近缘上,所有三个度量衡均被计算在二进制前地上,不包括背景. 利用同位相距将相距从花瓶转换为毫米。

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: V-A Statistical Analysis Methods
blocks.zh: V-A 统计分析方法

blocks.en: This subsection describes how the reported numbers and p p -values were obtained, for the ease of the reader.
blocks.zh: 本分节叙述报告的数字和p值是如何获得的,以便于读者阅读。

blocks.en: Case-level aggregation. Model performance is reported as mean ± \pm sample standard deviation across three independent training runs. The public MVSeg2023 release provides anonymized, single-frame end-diastolic volumes whose metadata are stripped except for image size and spacing; the dataset description states that each case represents one patient, but no patient identifiers or clinical attributes are released. The unit of analysis is therefore the test case (volume), and independence across cases is assumed from the dataset description rather than verified. Because all runs are evaluated on the same 40 held-out cases, conditions are compared at the case level: each metric was first averaged across the three runs for every case and condition, giving one value per case and condition ( n = 40 n=40 ) that uses all runs rather than a single seed.
blocks.zh: 案例一级汇总。 模型性能报告为平均±\pm样本标准差,跨越了3个独立训练运行. 公开的MVSeg2023发布提供了匿名的,单帧的终极-截面卷,除图像大小和相距外,其元数据被剥去;数据集描述指出,每个病例代表一个病人,但没有发布患者识别特征或临床属性. 因此,分析单位是测试案例(数量),从数据集描述中假定各案例的独立性,而不是加以核实。 由于所有跑步都是在相同的40个被搁置的案例中评价的,因此在案例一级比较了条件:每跑出3个案例和条件,每跑出1个,每个案例和条件(n=40个n=40个)使用所有跑出而不是单一种子。

blocks.en: Paired comparisons. For two conditions, the paired difference is computed for each case and defined so that positive values indicate improvement (GDS increase; HD95 and Surface Distance reduction). Significance is assessed with a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test, a non-parametric test of whether the paired differences are centered on zero that does not assume normally distributed differences ( W W denotes its test statistic). Uncertainty in the mean paired difference is given by a paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval (CI), obtained by resampling cases with replacement. A CI that contains zero means the mean difference is not clearly distinguishable from zero; this can occur alongside a significant Wilcoxon result, because the rank-based test and the mean-based interval summarize the difference differently.
blocks.zh: 相类相取. 对于两个条件,每个情况都计算成对相差,并界定成正值,以显示改善(GDS增加;HD95和地表距离减少)。 意义用双侧的Wilcoxon签名分级测试来评估,该测试是对配对差异是否以零为中心进行非参数测试,而零不假设正常分布差异(WW表示其测试统计). 平均配对差异的不确定性通过一个配对的靴子接住95%的置信间隔(CI)给出,通过以替换方式对病例进行再取样得到. 包含0的CI表示平均差与0没有明显的区别;这可以和一个显著的Wilcoxon结果一起发生,因为基于分级的测试和基于平均的间隔对差异进行不同的总结.

blocks.en: Multiple comparisons. Because three metrics are tested per comparison, Holm correction was applied across the three metrics within each pre-specified comparison, and all p p -values reported below are Holm-adjusted ( p Holm p_{\mathrm{Holm}} ) unless stated otherwise. As a conservative robustness check, Holm correction was also applied jointly across all nine generator-by-metric comparisons against the 390-update baseline ( p Holm , 9 p_{\mathrm{Holm,9}} ). The comparisons performed were: ChatGPT-, Gemini-, and MAI-FDA against the 390-update real-only baseline; ChatGPT-FDA and the non-AI FDA control against the 540-update real-only control; and the non-AI FDA control against ChatGPT-FDA.
blocks.zh: 多相比较. 由于每次比较都测试出3个度量衡,霍尔姆校正在每次预先指定的度量衡中被应用到3个度量衡中,下面所报告出的所有p-值都是霍尔姆校正(p Holm p-_{\mathrm{Holm}}),除非另有说明. 作为保守的强性检查,Holm校正还被联合应用于所有9个发电机逐个比对390更新基准(p Holm,9 p_{\-mathrm{Holm,9}}). 所作的比较是:ChatGPT、双子座和MAI-FDA与390更新的仅限真实基线比较;ChatGPT-FDA和非AIFDA控制与540更新的仅限真实控制比较;以及非AIFDA对ChatGPT-FDA的控制.

blocks.en: FDA Parameter sensitivity. For the FDA parameter β \beta sensitivity experiment, case-level metrics were averaged over runs for each β \beta and compared with an overall Friedman test, a non-parametric test for differences across three or more related conditions, with Holm-corrected pairwise Wilcoxon tests and paired bootstrap intervals for follow-up. The Friedman analysis was repeated after excluding Seed 1 (averaging Seeds 2 and 3) to assess sensitivity to between-run variability. Friedman p p -values are reported as obtained.

blocks.en: Comparison with the 390-update baseline. ChatGPT-FDA increased mean GDS from 0.8198 to 0.8268, a non-significant paired improvement of 0.0071 (bootstrap 95% CI: [ − 0.0011 , 0.0168 ] [-0.0011,\,0.0168] ; W = 306 W=306 ), with higher GDS in 23 of 40 cases and lower in 17. Gemini-FDA likewise showed no GDS difference ( − 0.0005 -0.0005 ; 95% CI: [ − 0.0106 , 0.0102 ] [-0.0106,\,0.0102] ; W = 394 W=394 ; higher in 20 cases, lower in 20). In contrast, MAI-FDA significantly improved GDS by 0.0111 (95% CI: [ 0.0034 , 0.0209 ] [0.0034,\,0.0209] ; W = 176 W=176 ), with improvement in 30 of 40 cases. HD95 and Surface Distance were significantly reduced for all three generator-guided conditions; for ChatGPT-FDA, HD95 decreased from 6.0005 to 3.0569 mm (95% CI: [ 1.2460 , 5.1259 ] [1.2460,\,5.1259] mm; improved in 28 of 40 cases) and Surface Distance from 1.2911 to 0.5866 mm (95% CI: [ 0.3337 , 1.2319 ] [0.3337,\,1.2319] mm; improved in all 40). The boundary improvements were therefore consistent across generators, whereas the GDS effect was generator-dependent. These conclusions were unchanged under a more conservative Holm correction applied jointly across all nine generator-by-metric tests: the MAI-FDA GDS improvement remained significant ( p Holm , 9 = 0.00492 p_{\mathrm{Holm,9}}=0.00492 ), as did all HD95 and Surface Distance reductions, and the ChatGPT-FDA and Gemini-FDA GDS differences remained non-significant.

blocks.en: Comparison with the 540-update control. The optimization-matched real-only control achieved GDS of 0.7921 ± 0.0441 0.7921\pm 0.0441 , HD95 of 3.7590 ± 1.1742 3.7590\pm 1.1742 mm, and Surface Distance of 0.6529 ± 0.2691 0.6529\pm 0.2691 mm. blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The standardized three-run analysis shows that FDA-based augmentation does not produce a uniform improvement across every segmentation metric. Among the six experimental conditions reported in Table I , MAI-FDA had the numerically highest mean GDS, the non-AI FDA control had the numerically lowest mean HD95, and Gemini-FDA had the numerically lowest mean Surface Distance. All four FDA-based conditions substantially reduced mean boundary-error metrics relative to the primary real-only baseline, whereas traditional augmentation did not improve the primary baseline. However, since the parameters of traditional augmentation were fixed a priori and not tuned, one should not conclude that the conventional augmentation was ineffective.

The control experiments further refine the interpretation of these results.
Relative to the 390-update baseline, the GDS effect was donor-dependent: only MAI-FDA gave a significant paired improvement ( Δ = 0.0111 \Delta=0.0111 , p Holm = 0.00123 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=0.00123 ), whereas HD95 and Surface Distance were significantly reduced for all three generator-guided conditions. The most reproducible effect is thus reduced boundary and surface error, while improved overlap is not shared across generators.

blocks.en: The 540-update real-only control addresses optimization budget. ChatGPT-FDA showed a significant GDS advantage over it, so its result is not attributable solely to extra updates. Because this control had lower GDS but better boundary metrics than the 390-update baseline, longer training appears to shift the overlap–boundary trade-off. The two controls are therefore treated as complementary.
blocks.zh: 540-更新的唯真控制处理优化预算. ChatGPT-FDA显示出了GDS相比它具有显著的优势,因此其结果并不仅仅归功于额外的更新. 由于这种控制比390年更新基线更低的GDS但更好的边界衡量标准,较长的培训似乎改变了重叠的边界取舍。 因此,这两种控制是相辅相成的。

blocks.en:
Real training-image style donors yielded GDS and HD95 similar to ChatGPT-FDA (no significant difference), so FDA is an important mechanism but generative-AI donor content is not shown to be uniquely beneficial. Its practical value is as an annotation-free source of 2D appearance variation transferable to labelled real volumes, rather than a generator of valid 3D volumes or labels.
In other words, generative-AI donor may be particularly useful when additional real appearance donors are unavailable or costly to collect.
blocks.zh:
真正的训练-图像风格捐赠者产生了与ChatGPT-FDA相似的GDS和HD95(没有显著区别),因此FDA是重要的机制,但基因-AI捐赠者的内容并没有显示出独特的好处. 其实用价值是作为2D外观变异的无注释来源可被转移至被标记为真实量,而不是生成有效的3D卷或标签.
换句话说,当没有其他真正的捐助者或收集费用昂贵时,AI基因捐助者可能特别有用。

blocks.en: Finally, The FDA parameter β \beta sensitivity analysis therefore points to substantial between-run variability and does not support a universal claim that one tested β \beta value is optimal.
blocks.zh: 终于 因此,FDA参数β\β的灵敏度分析指出运行间有大量可变性,不支持一个普遍的说法,即测试β\β值是最佳的.

blocks.en:
Limitations. First, MVSeg2023 is anonymized, with no patient identifiers or diagnostic metadata, so independence across cases is assumed and performance could not be stratified by valve pathology. Also, the test cohort has only 40 real MVSeg2023 volumes. Thus, external validation on an independent 3D TEE dataset is needed. Second, FDA alters appearance statistics but creates no new valve anatomy or pathology. Third, only three runs per condition limit inference on between-run variability. Fourth, clinical morphometrics (e.g., mitral annular area, inter-commissural distance, tenting area) could not be derived because the binary masks lack the required landmarks and reference planes. Fifth, the six-condition comparison reported in Table I used an epoch-matched design (390 updates for the primary real-only baseline, 540 for FDA conditions).
We therefore report both a direct paired comparison with the original 390-update Table 1 baseline and a separate 540-update real-only control that matches the FDA optimization budget. The GDS conclusions differ between these comparisons: the ChatGPT-FDA GDS increase was not significant relative to the original 390-update baseline but was significant relative to the 540-update matched control. Accordingly, overlap and boundary metrics are interpreted separately rather than treating either baseline comparison as universally definitive.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: We evaluated general-purpose generative-AI images as 2D appearance donors for label-preserving, slice-wise Fourier Domain Adaptation in 3D mitral-valve segmentation. In the standardized six-condition three-run comparison, MAI-FDA achieved the numerically highest mean GDS (0.8309 ± \pm 0.0129), the non-AI FDA control the lowest mean HD95 (3.0208 ± \pm 0.3519 mm), and Gemini-FDA the lowest mean Surface Distance (0.5712 ± \pm 0.1460 mm). Relative to the 390-update real-only baseline, HD95 and Surface Distance were significantly reduced for all three generative-AI donors, making improved boundary accuracy the most consistent finding, whereas the GDS effect was generator-dependent (significant only for MAI-FDA: Δ = 0.0111 \Delta=0.0111 , p Holm = 0.00123 p_{\mathrm{Holm}}=0.00123 ), although ChatGPT-FDA also showed a significant GDS advantage over the 540-update matched control. Since a non-AI FDA control using real training images as style donors performed comparably on GDS and HD95, this supports FDA as an important augmentation mechanism without establishing that generative-AI donors are superior to real-image donors. Generative models nonetheless offer a practical, annotation-free source of 2D appearance diversity that can be transferred to already-labelled real 3D volumes without requiring synthetic voxel-level masks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了通用基因AI图像作为2D外观捐赠者,用于在3D相位-阀分中保持标签,切片-明智的Fourier域适应. 在标准化的六条件三跑比较中,MAI-FDA实现了数值上最高的平均值GDS(0.8309 ±\pm 0.0129),非AI FDA控制了最低的平均值HD95(3.0208 ±\pm 0.3519 mm),双子座-FDA实现了最小的平均值地表距离(0.5712 ±\pm 0.1460 mm). 相对于390更新的仅限真实的基线,HD95和表面距离在所有三个基因-AI捐赠者中都被大幅降低,使得边界精确度的提高是最一致的发现,而GDS效应是依赖发电机的(仅对MAI-FDA: = 0.0111\Delta= 0.0111,pholm= 0.00123 p_{\-mathrm{Holm}}=0.00123),尽管ChatGPT-FDA在540更新匹配的控制上也显示出了显著的GDS优势. 由于非AI林业发展局采用真正的培训图像作为风格捐助方在GDS和HD95上的表现相仿,这支持林业发展局作为一个重要的增强机制,而没有确定基因-AI捐助方优于真实图像捐助方。 尽管如此,基因模型还是提供了2D外观多样性的实用而无注释的来源,可以被转移到已经贴有标签的真3D卷而不需要合成活塞级口罩.
